summary: Join us in shaping the future of electronic trading as a Junior/Intermediate Software Engineer (Backend) at Flipster, contributing to the design and development of cutting-edge micro-service-based trading system components from scratch.
responsibilities: Design and development of microservice-based electronic trading system components from scratch.
Develop features and improvements to our products in a secure, well-tested, and performant way
required_skills: Thorough knowledge of computer architecture and networks
A firm grasp of good principles of software engineering, like TDD
Hands-on experience delivering real-time data over the web
Strong sense of ownership, urgency, and drive
nice_to_have_skills: Operating system, and network layer performance tuning
System design, and large distributed systems
education_level: Computer Science / Engineering degree is preferable
